views.front: The small chair retains its wrapped back and four metal legs; the seat now has a quiet rounded rectangular crown.
views.rear: The curved back has continuous smooth surfaces and remains seated above the original leg frame.
views.detail: Full-size inspection shows continuous fine seat piping on the cover, without the previous floating corners or puckered edge.
views.underside: The original lower pan and four capped legs remain closed and connected; no additional underside openings appear.
views.clay: The neutral view confirms a coherent child chair silhouette. Its inherited thick cushion remains a stylized proportion, acceptable at application scale.
